units: <cite ref="Shabbat 105a:13">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="S01172"><he>קירוס</he></cite>) <he>מ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>מצוביי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) the thrums or slips to which the threads of the warp are attached.

<cite ref="Shabbat 105b:9">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>שליף מצוביי׳</he> Ms. O. a. Rashi (ed. <cite ref="M02266"><he>מְצַבְיָיתָא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>מְצוּבָתָא</he>; Ms. Alf. <cite ref="M01859"><he>מְסוּבִיתָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="O00524"><he>סִיב</he></cite>) pulled the thrums (of his garment, to indicate his anger).—[

<cite ref="Sukkah 29a:4">Succ. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא זיקא וקא מבלבל מ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וקא מייתי ציבותא</he>; Ms. M. 1 <cite ref="R00044"><he>צבייתא</he></cite>; 2 <cite ref="R00322"><he>ציוותא</he></cite>; ed. Pes. a. oth. <he>צִיבֵּי</he>) a wind came and stirred up the withered twigs of the covering of the Succah.
